title: Volume
brief: Write a literary story about a retired piano tuner, newly fitted with hearing aids, who hears his wife's voice clearly for the first time in eight years and realises how much he had been guessing. One afternoon, one kitchen. No epiphany speeches.
worldBible: Present day, a terraced house in a northern English town.
The hearing aids are behind-the-ear, fitted that morning.
His wife has been speaking louder for years without saying so.
The piano in the front room has not been tuned since he retired.
It is raining for the entire story.
